bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; designating a segment of marked Trunk Highway 23 in Kandiyohi County as Joshua Schmidt Memorial Highway; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 161.14, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 161.14, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 108.

Joshua Schmidt Memorial Highway.

That segment of marked Trunk Highway 23 in Kandiyohi County from its intersection with U.S. Highway 71 north of Willmar to Lake Avenue South in Spicer is designated as "Joshua Schmidt Memorial Highway." Subject to section 161.139, the commissioner shall adopt a suitable design to mark this highway and erect appropriate signs.
additions: That segment of marked Trunk Highway 23 in Kandiyohi County from its intersection with U.S. Highway 71 north of Willmar to Lake Avenue South in Spicer is designated as "Joshua Schmidt Memorial Highway." Subject to section 161.139, the commissioner shall adopt a suitable design to mark this highway and erect appropriate signs.
